result.stdout:
XamlNexus - Windows desktop prototype scaffolding

Quick start:
  xamlnexus new MyApp
  cd MyApp
  xamlnexus run
  Stop with Ctrl+C before editing or running again.
  Edit MyApp.MainPanel/MainPage.xaml and ViewModels/MainViewModel.cs.
  xamlnexus page add Workspace
  xamlnexus run
  After stopping: xamlnexus add sqlite, then xamlnexus run.

Usage:
  xamlnexus                         Start interactive mode
  xamlnexus new <name> [options]    Create a project
  xamlnexus page add <name> [--project <directory>] [--no-navigation] 
[--dry-run] [--json]
    Add a page; --no-navigation skips navigation registration.
  xamlnexus run [path] [--project <directory>] [--no-build] [--dry-run] [--json]
    Build and run Debug/x64 unpackaged; Ctrl+C stops this run.
    --no-build uses existing output; no watch or hot reload.
  xamlnexus list [path] [--json]    List project capabilities
  xamlnexus validate [path] [--json] Validate the manifest and managed files
  xamlnexus doctor [path] [--json] Diagnose environment and project health
  xamlnexus upgrade [path] [options] Upgrade scaffold-managed infrastructure
  xamlnexus recipes [--json]        List built-in Recipes
  xamlnexus add <recipe[,recipe...]> [options]  Install Recipes transactionally
  xamlnexus remove <recipe> [options] Remove a Recipe transactionally
  xamlnexus update <recipe> [options] Update a Recipe transactionally
  xamlnexus --help                  Show help (aliases: help, -h, -?)
  xamlnexus --version               Show version

New options:
  -n, --name <name>                 Project name (or use the positional name)
  -p, --preset <preset>             winui (default) or hybrid
  -o, --output <directory>          Parent output directory (default: current 
directory)
      --profile <standard|basic>    Starting capability profile (default: 
standard)
                                    basic omits the full settings panel; core 
services remain.
      --features <ids>               Install comma-separated Recipes during 
creation
  -l, --language <language>
[truncated]
